Help Center

Helpful answers, without the sales language.

A concise overview of what OrgVia is designed to help organizations manage.

What is HRMS software?

Human resource management system software helps an organization keep employee information and people-related workflows in a central system rather than across separate, disconnected tools.

How does OrgVia manage employee leave?

OrgVia includes leave management as part of its HRMS workflow areas, helping teams keep leave-related work connected to employee and operational context.

What is included in OrgVia’s payroll workflow?

OrgVia supports payroll workflows alongside employee and attendance context. A product demonstration should confirm specific configuration and process requirements.

How do HR administrators manage access?

OrgVia is a multi-tenant platform with role-appropriate organizational administration. Exact permissions and available controls should be confirmed against your implementation.

How does organization onboarding work?

OrgVia supports onboarding as one of the people-operation workflow areas. The practical setup process depends on the organization configuration and implementation plan.

Can I book a demonstration?

Yes. You can use the demo request page. In this build, a secure delivery destination still needs to be configured before requests can be transmitted.
